name: Handle Changed or New QBO Customer ( {QBO Customer } )
purpose: Entry point for a QuickBooks Online customer change: converts the QBO customer JSON into a Karbon customer JSON, looks up an existing link (ExternalLink with type 5) for that QBO id, and then either updates the found customer or creates a new Karbon customer from it.
reads: ExternalLink::InternalId#2 (SQL.GetColumn2Fields step 27, where ExternalLink::ExternalId#10 = QBO id and ExternalLink::ExternalLinkTypeId#9 = 5)
calls:
karbon_kontroller.fmp12/scripts/169 "Convert QBO Customer Into Karbon Customer" (step 30; Perform Script)
karbon_kontroller.fmp12/scripts/276 "Update QBO Data for Found Customer ({QBOCustomer})" (step 35; Perform Script)
karbon_kontroller.fmp12/scripts/275 "Create Karbon Customer From QBO ( {KabonCustomer } )" (step 37; Perform Script)
open_question: Called from LedgerLink (Handle_Customer_Update step 9) through a file reference built from $$DataSourceControllerFile, which the data source list resolves to karbon_kontroller; confirm. External link type 5 is hard-coded as the QBO customer type. No error check on the converted customer before the update/create branch.
